name: simats-ai-recruitment-auotmation-system
description: A campus-aware recruitment automation platform for SIMATS (Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences), covering the full hiring lifecycle: vacancy requisition → multi-stage approval (Dean → HR) → job posting/publishing → candidate application → AI-assisted resume screening/ranking → interview scheduling and feedback → offers → joining → department/room allotment → orientation → hand-over to HOD, plus AI-assisted JD generation, an AI assistant ("Hermes"), executive dashboards with charts, and reporting/exports.
